provenance: BetaNYC modified this data: cleaned it, reshaped it, left some fields out, matched addresses to places, and joined it with other data. This copy should not be considered the official record. Official record: Expense Funding Disclosure spreadsheets (funded_disclosure_FYyyyy), Research & Data division (New York City Council), https://rnd.council.nyc.gov/expense_funding/

BetaNYC downloaded the Council's own workbooks from the Research & Data site (last on 2026-10-12) and committed them with their sha256 (source/expense-funding-disclosure/). This server answers from the SQLite index in its npm package, with no network call. The index is built from the copy committed to this repo. How current: the day BetaNYC downloaded the copy, read from the index.

Modified by BetaNYC: Amounts, names and statuses are as published; exact copies of a row are kept and flagged. Embedded total and footer rows are stripped, never counted. The purpose text is not served. Added by BetaNYC: a 5-digit ZIP from the published postal code (a ragged or 6-digit ZIP repaired only into a 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) of the row's own state, or settled by the street address where it matches exactly one address in the City's Property Address Directory (PAD)), the Council Member's Legistar person ID from BetaNYC's member crosswalk, and, FY2009–FY2021, the Mayor's Office of Contract Services (MOCS) ID that NYC Open Data dataset 4d7f-74pe gives the same designation, where the pairing is unambiguous.

provenance: BetaNYC produced this. It is not an official record. Built from: NYC Council Legistar (people and recorded votes), https://legistar.council.nyc.gov/People.aspx

BetaNYC extracted the roster and each person's recorded votes from the Legistar index that @betanyc/nyc-council-mcp builds, committed that extract (data/reference/), and resolved each printed name by fixed rules (code/build_member_crosswalk.py): the only person with that name who voted in that fiscal year. The crosswalk is in the server's index; how current is the day that Legistar index was built.

Modified by BetaNYC: A name is resolved only when exactly one Legistar person with that name voted in that fiscal year. A name two such people share is left ambiguous with its candidates, never guessed. A few printed forms were matched by hand, each with its evidence recorded. Delegations, 'Speaker', district labels and blanks get no person ID.
